rationale: The failed-gap distribution thesis is fully intact — price remains ~0.9% below VWAP and under the 9-EMA on 4.6x relative volume, and the post-entry candles show a shrinking-volume drift at the lows (no reclaim, no absorption, no reversal bar), which reads as a bear flag rather than a bottom. Adverse excursion (-0.08%) is well inside the 68.55 invalidation and the 67.85 target still offers ~2.3:1, so neither closing nor flipping to long has any supporting evidence.
